Sygnal component.description: A typed Sygnal component in the canonical forms: Component<State, Props, {}, ActionsOf<typeof intent>>, IntentSources, object-form model, initialState
body: import type { ActionsOf, Component, IntentSources } from 'sygnal'

Sygnal model entry with EFFECT.description: A model entry that only runs a side effect (EFFECT sink; call next('ACTION', data) to dispatch)

Sygnal model entry emitting an EVENTS ev.description: A model entry that updates state and emits a global event with event() (import { event } from 'sygnal'; receive it with EVENTS.select('TYPE'); register the type in SygnalEvents to type-check it)
